note: Released board design for the board-level example. Stands in for the full design package (schematic, Gerbers, pick-and-place); its digest is the board HBOM's design subject.

bom.description: Bare PCB, 4 layer FR-4, 50 x 40 mm
PicoSoC on SKY130, QFN-64 (the example chip)
128 Mbit SPI NOR flash, SOIC-8, holds the bootloader and runtime images
1.8 V 500 mA LDO for the core, SOT-23-5
3.3 V 500 mA LDO for I/O and flash, SOT-23-5
